title: Withdrawal of corpus.
bodyText: Withdrawal of all, or any portion of, the corpus of the reserve trust fund shall be upon the written authorization signed by at least two-thirds of the members of the board of trustees.
bodyHtml: §435E-18  Withdrawal of corpus.  Withdrawal of all, or any portion of, the corpus of the reserve trust fund shall be upon the written authorization signed by at least two-thirds of the members of the board of trustees. [L 1977, c 182, pt of §1]
